item.title: Reminder: Use Your Summer 2026 Block Plan Meal Swipes
item.description: Attention Summer 2026 Block Plan users. This is a friendly reminder to use all of your Summer 2026 meal plan swipes before the end of the day on Friday, August 14. Any unused meal swipes remaining after August 14 will expire and cannot be carried over or refunded.

item.title: Seeking a Highly Motivated RPI Undergraduate or Master’s Student to Join a Research Project
item.description: We are seeking a highly motivated RPI undergraduate or master’s student to join a research project focused on developing optimization methods for collaborative school transportation planning. The position is available as a paid hourly research assistantship or for academic credit, depending on the student’s interests and eligibility. item.title: WITS Feeder Workshop on Quantum Machine Learning
item.description: Lally will host the WITS Feeder Workshop on Quantum Machine Learning, bringing together researchers and industry leaders to explore the intersection of quantum computing, AI, and real-world decision-making. Through research presentations, industry perspectives, demonstrations, and a featured panel, the workshop will examine emerging applications and their implications for business, science, and government.

item.title: ISSS Town Hall: Duration of Status (D/S) Changes
item.description: ISSS is holding a Town Hall to share information about the recent regulatory change to Duration of Status (D/S) that affects individuals in F-1 and J-1 status and their dependents. This event is open to the campus community, and this session focus is on answering student questions. Join us virtually on Thursday, August 13, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. Register here: https://tinyurl.com/RPI-DS-townhall

item.title: Updates to the student experience
item.description: As we prepare for the year ahead, you are invited to join us for a campus-wide conversation about updates designed to support and strengthen the student experience on August 19 from 9–11 a.m. at CBIS, Auditorium.
